title: PaymentAuthorized.v1
description: Published to Service Bus queue 'payment-authorized' after a payment is successfully authorised by the provider.

rules: Additive fields (new optional properties) are allowed within v1 — consumers must ignore unknown fields.
Removing, renaming, or changing the meaning of any existing field requires a new version (v2).
Breaking changes must be published under a new eventType value (e.g. PaymentAuthorized.v2) and the old type retired after a migration window.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event envelope. Used for deduplication.

traceId.description: W3C TraceContext trace-id for distributed tracing.
